name: Flux-Limited Diffusion
definition: An enhancement to classical diffusion theory that modifies the diffusion coefficient based on the local Knudsen number to enforce the physical constraint that flux magnitude does not exceed fluence, ensuring accuracy in heterogeneous media with low opacity.
summary: Flux-Limited Diffusion is a numerical method for radiative transfer that modifies the classical diffusion approximation by using a flux-limited coefficient to ensure accuracy in heterogeneous media and vacuum regions.
